title: The Erdős–Tuza–Valtr conjecture
abstract: Formalizes the Erdős–Tuza–Valtr conjecture, a sharp refinement of the Erdős–Szekeres happy-ending theorem, proving that any general-position point set of size at least C(n+2,2)+2 contains the target cup–cap configuration.

informal.ErdosTuzaValtr.main: Proves the sharp upper bound — a general-position point set with at least C(n+2,2)+2 points contains the Erdős–Tuza–Valtr cup–cap configuration.
informal.Config.main_lemma: The configuration-relative induction lemma that, with the mirror-symmetry reduction, drives the main proof.
